summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.95. Confirmed account takeover for d.yilmaz@aegean.edu. Evidence chain: phishing email from typosquat domain aegean-edu.co delivered 06:12, user clicked verification link 06:15, then MFA fatigue attack from 185.220.101.7 (BulwarkHost Ltd, Amsterdam) with 7 mfa_denied prompts followed by mfa_approved and a successful mail login at 06:59:30 (mfa_prompt_count=8) — impossible travel vs. normal baseline on 193.140.10.44 (Turkcell, Manisa, device LT-2207). Attacker then created an inbox forwarding rule to external d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com at 07:03 and rapidly enumerated SIS (~40 logins in under a minute) from the same hostile hosting IP with no device_id. Credential phish + MFA bypass + foreign IP session + external forwarding rule + data access = confirmed compromise requiring immediate containment (disable account, force password reset, revoke all sessions, remove forwarding rule, inspect mail/SIS access).
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
